artworks.title: Venice
artworks.medium: watercolor over black chalk
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 17.2 x 24.6 cm (6 3/4 x 9 11/16 in.)
support: 18.9 x 26.6 cm (7 7/16 x 10 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The painting shows a waterfront scene with red and white sailboats on the water to the left. In the background, there are pink buildings with white and teal domes and a tall clock tower. On the far right, people are walking along a gray pathway next to the water. The sky is blue and filled with fluffy clouds in white, purple, and pink. The brushstrokes are loose and thick, and the off-white paper below shows through in several places.

artworks.title: George Mills
artworks.medium: pastel with gray and brown wash on two overlapped sheets of laid paper joined at the top
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. He faces slightly to the right, with his gaze directed towards the viewer. The man has light-colored, curly hair styled neatly, falling just above his collar. His features include a youthful face with fair skin, eyebrows, and lips. He wears historical attire: a deep blue coat with brass buttons, a white waistcoat, and a white cravat tied at the neck. The background shows an indistinct, neutral-toned wall that suggests an interior space.

artworks.title: Mrs. George Mills
artworks.medium: charcoal and pastel on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman's upper body in profile, facing left. She has delicate facial features, soft expression, high styled hair covered by a large bonnet, and wears an elegant dress with ruffled details and a fitted waist. She wears a black ribbon choker. The background includes a tree, suggesting an outdoor scene. The artwork features soft, pastel coloration.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman in Profile
artworks.medium: black chalk and watercolor
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in profile from the waist up. She has delicate facial features, a smooth complexion, and a slightly pointed nose. Her hair is styled in an updo with curls, possibly adorned with a hairpiece. She wears a dress with a cinched waist, detailed with a belt or band with a circular ornament. The dress appears to be subtly draped. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is an oval frame with dark clouds and a lighter, hazy area behind the figure.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman with a Blue Sash
artworks.medium: black chalk and watercolor
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a woman's upper body in profile facing left. She has a refined profile with a slightly upturned nose and delicate chin. Her hair is styled in tight curls with a headband. She wears a light-colored gown with a scoop neckline and a darker sash around her waist. The gown appears to have subtle designs or embroidery. She wears a necklace made of beads or pearls. The background shows a softly shaded, cloudy sky within an oval border.

artworks.title: Woman Seated at a Table, Holding a Letter
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 34.3 x 24.2 cm (13 1/2 x 9 1/2 in.)
support: 40.5 x 30.2 cm (15 15/16 x 11 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a three-quarter profile. She has fair skin, light-colored hair styled in soft curls, and wears a light-colored cap. She is dressed in an elegant dark gown with lace detailing, a light-colored skirt, and a white shawl. She holds an envelope with a red wax seal in her right hand. Next to her is a table with a letter-writing set and a fabric piece. The background features tall trees seen through a window or open drapery.

artworks.title: Two Children
artworks.artist: British 19th Century after George Henry Harlow
artworks.medium: mezzotint
artworks.description: The image depicts an artistic drawing of two children's upper bodies facing each other. One child has shoulder-length curly hair and a profile view, looking up at the other child. The child on the right has a round face, short hair under a bonnet, and is in a three-quarter view looking down. Both children wear simple, flowing garments without visible patterns. The drawing is done in soft pencil tones with a hint of color, giving a gentle appearance. The background is plain paper with a fading oval vignette effect, emphasizing the children.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man in a Military Uniform
artworks.medium: black, blue, and red chalk heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays an oval portrait of a man's upper torso. He is turned slightly to the right, looking directly at the viewer with a composed expression. The man has pale skin, defined facial features, softly arched eyebrows, a subtle mustache, and styled hair in an 18th-century fashion. He wears a blue coat with white lapels, silver buttons, and a silver-fringed epaulet on the shoulder, along with a cravat and waistcoat. The background is a smooth, neutral gray.

artworks.title: Carriage with Driver and Groom: Autumn
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and watercolor
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse-drawn carriage. The image shows a carriage pulled by two horses. The horses are depicted with a loose and flowing style typical of sketch work. The horses stand side by side, with their heads slightly turned. The carriage is illustrated with elegance and minimal detailing. The background of the drawing suggests a street-side setting with faint outlines of buildings. The individuals associated with the carriage are represented in a simplified manner, wearing period-appropriate attire. The overall tonal quality of the drawing is purposefully muted.

artworks.title: Carriage with Driver and Groom: Spring
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and watercolor
artworks.description: This is a painting of a horse-drawn carriage. It depicts two horses hitched to a carriage using watercolor and ink in light blues and earthy tones. The carriage is blue, with a coachman wearing a traditional uniform and a top hat sitting atop it. Another figure, similarly dressed, stands beside the carriage. The horses have noticeable musculature and realistic details. Soft shadows are cast on the ground beneath them, and the background suggests an open, light atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Duchess of Kent's State Carriage
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite
artworks.description: This is a painting of a military procession. The painting depicts a scene of a parade or inspection with soldiers and horses. A central group of mounted figures could denote a leader or dignitary with a distinctive hat, surrounded by guards on horseback. The soldiers are dressed in historical military attire with decorative uniforms and helmets, suggesting a ceremonial event. The left side features soldiers carrying spears, and there are horses with blue saddle decorations adding color to the scene. The background is a soft blend of blues and earth tones.

artworks.title: Three-Quarter Portrait of a Young Girl
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person from the waist up. The individual is positioned with their body angled to the side and their head turned towards the viewer's left. The person has curly hair, partially covered by a large hat casting a shadow on their face. Their facial features are detailed with emphasis on the nose and lips. The clothing is loosely sketched, depicting a collared garment with button details and subtle coloring. The person's hands are on their hips, creating a confident pose. The background is a wash of light grayish hues, giving a soft texture and allowing the figure to stand out.

artworks.title: The Artist’s Sister Edma Seated on a Bench
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This painting shows a woman seated on a gray, curved bench in a garden-like setting. She is positioned slightly sideways, with her torso and head turned to the left. The woman has fair skin and long, light brown hair peeking out from beneath a dark hat. She wears a high-collared dress and tan gloves, with her hands on her lap, holding a light-colored parasol. Next to her on the bench is a bouquet of pink and white flowers. The background features tall trees and greenery. The brushstrokes in the painting are thick and visible.

artworks.title: The Artist's Sister, Edma, with Her Daughter, Jeanne (recto); The Artist's Sister Edma Seated Outdoors (verso)
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on laid paper (recto); graphite on laid paper (verso)
artworks.description: This painting shows two people sitting together on a sofa, a woman on the right and a child on the left. The woman is turned slightly towards the child as she leans against one of the arms of the sofa. She wears a light-colored dress with a blue floral pattern and a black waistband, and she holds a thin red-and-yellow object in her hand, perhaps a closed fan. She has a black necklace and a black bow in her hair. Both the woman and the child have pale blue-white skin and light brown hair. The child looks out at us, wearing a light-colored dress with a pale pink ribbon around the waist. The sofa they sit on is brown with pink cushions. The background is painted in light strokes of gray, with beige paper visible around the edges. Colorful brush marks are visible around the painting's border, as if the artist was testing the different colors.

artworks.title: Girl Seated
artworks.medium: watercolor over traces of graphite on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an artistic rendering of a person, capturing their upper half. The person is seated in a chair, facing forward in a relaxed posture. Their facial features are softly defined with subtle highlights, and their hair is short and dark, styled closely to the head. The attire is a delicate garment with ruffled detailing around the neckline, depicted in soft pink shades. The arms of the chair and surrounding space are suggested with gentle brushstrokes in muted tones. The background is an indistinct, light wash of beige that complements the soft pastel tones of the person's clothing.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: colored pencils on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a high horizon, possibly viewed from an elevated position. The composition includes an expanse of open land, distant trees, and a haystack with surrounding foliage in the foreground. The scene is depicted with light, loose strokes in blue, yellow, red, and green giving an impressionistic quality. The palette consists of soft pastel tones creating a serene effect.

artworks.title: Spring Landscape
artworks.medium: colored pencils and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with trees viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon line is high, with tall trees stretching across. The brushstrokes are sketch-like, creating movement and texture. The color palette is soft with earthy tones of pale orange, yellow, green, and blue. The trees in the foreground are faintly outlined, leading the eye towards the mid-region with scattered trees and a blurred background.

artworks.title: Grove of Trees
artworks.medium: pen with brown and black ink, gray wash, and graphite on gray-blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape sketch from a straight-on perspective. The horizon line is low, with subtle lines indicating the ground and trees meeting the earth. A group of trees is central, with detailed foliage and texture created by pencil strokes. Tall trees are visible in the distance to the right. The drawing features gentle, detailed lines outlining the trees, with light shading suggesting depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey and the paper color to create a serene scene.

artworks.title: Houses by a Road
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with graphite on gray-blue laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing is from a lower perspective, looking up a hill on the left towards a group of buildings, with a path or road winding into the distance on the right. The houses on the hill face the right, and we see them from the side. They have pointed roofs with some low chimneys, and low trees or bushes are between them. Closer to us, at the base of the hill, there is a low stone wall and grassy vegetation beside the path, while more buildings are visible in the distance under a clear sky. The drawing is done in dark gray lines on a light gray background.

artworks.title: Woman Working in a Garden
artworks.medium: watercolor over black chalk on wove paper

artworks.title: Young Woman Standing
artworks.medium: black chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a standing woman in profile. She has a wide-brimmed hat casting a shadow on her face, which is softly sketched. Her attire includes a long-sleeved top and skirt. Her hands are clasped in front of her chest. The background is plain and light-colored.

artworks.title: A Bridge and Campanile, Venice
artworks.medium: watercolor over black chalk on thick wove paper
artworks.description: This painting depicts a scene of a bridge over a canal. The perspective is close to the water, with buildings on the left side and in the background behind the pale blue bridge. The buildings include a tall tan belltower in the center of the painting. On the left, a long brown boat floats in the water by the buildings. The buildings are in shades of cream, teal, dark blue, brown, pink, and peach. The canal is mostly gray and white, but it reflects some shades of blue and peach from the buildings. The sky above is cream. The painting uses soft pastel colors and fluid, visible brushstrokes, causing some of the colors to blend together.

artworks.title: Camprodón, Spain
artworks.medium: transparent and opaque watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: This painting shows a street surrounded by tall buildings seen from above. At the bottom of the painting, two indistinct figures are walking along the light gray road. Behind them, the road disappears through a passageway or archway in a tall wall. The buildings on either side of the road are cream, with red roofs and gutters. They have several dark windows and doorways near the street. The sky above the buildings has soft white clouds against a pastel blue background.

artworks.title: Gondola Moorings on the Grand Canal
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on thick wove paper
artworks.description: This painting shows a view along a blue canal with buildings lining the waterway. To the left of center is the curved end of a boat or gondola, suggesting that we are sitting in the boat. Beyond that, another boat is visible floating in the water. There are tall brown and blue poles to the left, spaced out along the canal. On the right, more poles stand in the water in front of steps leading up to a pale-yellow building with an arched doorway and a balcony hanging above. More buildings continue in a diagonal line, from the bottom right side to the center of the painting, where they turn into a horizontal line with a white bridge crossing the canal. The buildings are in shades of tan, light yellow, cream, pale blue, and light coral, many of them featuring balconies. The sky above the buildings is a clear, light blue, and the water of the canal reflects that. The brushstrokes in the painting are loose and fluid, and the colors overlap and blend.
